title: Composition of the specified refinement comparison at a retained witness
statement: Let Lambda be a finite commutative ring with its discrete topology. For a scheme morphism f:X to Y and compactifications c1,c2,c3 [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], suppose their ambient schemes are Noetherian. Let r:c1 to c2 and s:c2 to c3 be arbitrary refinements, with no Cartesian-square assumption. For any retained bounded-below etale-origin object O [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory], the fixed-scalar comparison defined in [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism] satisfies refinementComparisonAtWitness Lambda (r followed by s) O = refinementComparisonAtWitness Lambda r O followed by refinementComparisonAtWitness Lambda s O. This is an objectwise equality of isomorphisms in the ambient derived category of module sheaves on the pro-etale site of Y. It asserts neither naturality in O nor existence of common refinements nor the cocycle law for arbitrary compactifications.

proof.text: Apply the proper/open composition law on the retained bounded-below etale object. Transport it through the canonical bounded-below inclusion comparisons to the ambient derived category. The compositor in that equation is the finiteDirectImageComposition compositor: both are normalized by their right-derived units, so uniqueness of the right-derived extension identifies them.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2, last sentence; detailed proof step 6

proof.text: Expand refinementProperOpenIso. Denote J_i(alpha) by q_i. In composing the two inverse proper/open maps, the adjacent q_2.hom and q_2.inv cancel after functoriality of the proper direct image. Move q_1.inv through the direct-image compositor using its naturality. The equation from the first step now gives the inverse witnessed proper/open comparison for the composite refinement.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2, last sentence; detailed proof step 6

proof.text: Expand refinementComparisonAtWitness as direct-image compositor followed by proper image of the inverse witnessed proper/open comparison. Move the first inverse comparison through the second compositor by naturality. Associativity of the direct-image compositors identifies the result with the compositor of the composite refinement followed by the proper image of the composite inverse comparison from the preceding step. Its factorization equalities agree by category associativity and proof irrelevance. This is precisely the asserted equation of isomorphisms.

theorem refinementComparisonAtWitness_comp
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    [TopologicalSpace Λ] [DiscreteTopology Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c₁ c₂ c₃ : Compactification f}
    [IsNoetherian c₁.Z] [IsNoetherian c₂.Z] [IsNoetherian c₃.Z]
    (r : c₁ ⟶ c₂) (s : c₂ ⟶ c₃) (O : EtaleOriginDerivedCategory X Λ) :
    refinementComparisonAtWitness Λ (r ≫ s) O =
      refinementComparisonAtWitness Λ r O ≪≫ refinementComparisonAtWitness Λ s O
